title: NS Clipper v1.1.9
release_notes: NS Clipper v1.1.9: Gemini Interactions API with x-goog-api-key header; Deepgram nova-3 pinned; centralized model registry; Find Viral Clips Gemini 3.6 Flash only; deprecated models removed. v1.1.8 patch available.
changelog:
## AI Provider Fixes
- Gemini Interactions API with x-goog-api-key header; API keys never in URL query params.
- Audio size routing: <=15 MB inline, >15 MB Files API.
- Deepgram pinned nova-3; strict HTTP error classification.
- Key rotation only on 401/403.

## Model Registry
- model_registry.py centralises all AI model definitions.
- Find Viral Clips: Gemini 3.6 Flash (Recommended) only.
- Deprecated Gemini 2.x/1.x removed.
- Auto-migration of stale saved scoring model.

## Compatibility
- v1.1.8 patch available.
- v1.1.7 and earlier: full installer required.
_note: v1.1.8 receives patch if base hashes validate; v1.1.7 and earlier always receive full installer; unknown/modified installations always receive full installer.
